scope: Grade 2 bounded CA-specific distinctions, NOT whole Grade 2 coverage

rows.author_scope: Add and subtract within 1000 with concrete models or drawings and strategies using place value, operation properties or addition/subtraction relationships; connect to a written method and compose or decompose tens or hundreds.
Use estimation strategies to make reasonable estimates when solving problems.

Tell and write time from analog and digital clocks to nearest five minutes using a.m. and p.m.; California addition: know relationships of time such as minutes per hour, days per month, and weeks per year.
